reason: A file-based cross-conversation memory system that randomly collides stored discussion cards, applies scripted weighting and auditing, and generates status and weekly report outputs.

summaries.zh: 一个将跨对话讨论结论保存为本地卡片、通过加权随机碰撞产生联想并生成状态页与周报的记忆插件。
summaries.en: A file-based memory plugin that stores cross-conversation conclusions as cards, randomly collides them using scripted weighting, and generates status pages and weekly reports.

capabilities: Persists cross-conversation memory cards in local files
Performs weighted random sampling of stored memory cards
Updates memory weights and audit records through command-line scripts
Generates static status pages and weekly report HTML
Provides a host adapter for agent workflows
